question: CalPure Foods brand history headquarters
markdown:
CalPure Foods
is a California-based producer of extra virgin avocado oil. It was founded by vegetable farmers Michael and Erika Rutledge in Ventura County, California. The company was created to offer an American-made, cold-pressed alternative to imported and refined oils.
PR Newswire
Brand History
Founding:
Established in the mid-2010s by Californian farmers Michael and Erika Rutledge.
Mission:
Built to provide a high-grade, cold-pressed extra virgin avocado oil retaining natural nutrients, flavor, and color.
Growth:
Expanded distribution through specialty stores, online channels like Amazon Launchpad, and food service sectors.
PR Newswire
Headquarters & Sourcing
Headquarters:
Ventura County, California, United States.
Sourcing:
Avocados are harvested from regional California farms and select global partner farms meeting strict labor and financial standards.
